superiority_reason: Synthetic custom likelihood-informed track, one generation; no global-best/equal-research-effort claim
description: Samples a separate joint posterior for each spike train using independent Student-t Metropolis-Hastings proposals. A 4,000-draw pilot follows 1,000 burn-in steps to tune each proposal’s mean and full covariance. The final chain uses a fixed proposal, 1,000 burn-in steps, and saves every fifth state. Acceptance ratios use the supplied full prior precision and exact Bernoulli log posterior.
